tagline.zh: 人对一段体验的记忆主要由「峰值时刻」与「结尾感受」决定,而非全程平均。重点设计强度最高与收尾的时刻;负面峰值要专门消除。
tagline.en: People judge an experience by its peak moment and its ending, not the average. Design the highest-intensity and closing moments; eliminate negative peaks deliberately.

origin.zh: Kahneman 等人 1993 年冷水实验:被试对整段经历的记忆评估主要取决于峰值与结尾感受,而非时长或平均(Jon Yablonski,Laws of UX;调研 07§25)。相关 NN/g 文章:The Peak–End Rule: How Impressions Become Memories(Lexie Kane)。
origin.en: Kahneman et al.'s 1993 cold-water experiment: remembered evaluation of an episode hinges on its peak and its end, not duration or average (Jon Yablonski, Laws of UX; research 07 §25). Related NN/g piece: The Peak–End Rule: How Impressions Become Memories (Lexie Kane).

effect.zh: 旅程峰值时刻的体验强度(demo 构造的 8 段旅程第 3 段)。峰终定律的记忆评估按「峰值+结尾」主导;demo 用教科书化简公式 (峰值+结尾)/2 作为记忆预测,与全程平均对比。
effect.en: Experience intensity at the journey's peak (moment 3 of the demo's constructed 8-moment journey). Remembered evaluation is dominated by peak+end; the demo uses the textbook simplification (peak+end)/2 as the memory prediction, contrasted with the full average.

effect.zh: 旅程结尾时刻的体验强度(第 8 段)。默认 2 是「烂尾」旅程:峰值 8 的精彩被结尾 2 拖累,记忆预测只有 5——把 ending 拉到 9,看记忆预测怎么翻上去。
effect.en: Experience intensity at the journey's end (moment 8). Default 2 is a botched ending: a peak of 8 drags a memory prediction of just 5 — raise ending to 9 and watch the prediction jump.

effect.zh: 旅程预设(写入 peak/ending 两个参数)。cliff=烂尾(8/2);smooth=平顺(5/4);finale=惊喜收尾(6/9,Mailchimp 发送成功动画的思路,07§25);custom=保持当前滑块值。
effect.en: Journey presets (they write the peak/ending params). cliff = botched (8/2); smooth = even (5/4); finale = surprise ending (6/9, the Mailchimp success-animation idea, 07 §25); custom keeps the current sliders.

note.zh: 演示用内联 SVG 绘制体验曲线,全现代浏览器可用。
note.en: The curve is inline SVG; all modern browsers.

fallback.zh: 定律的工程出口:在旅程的两个时刻上做确定性设计——「强度最高处」(达成、揭晓、意外之喜)与「收尾处」(提交成功页、任务完成态、退出确认)。没有可降级的 CSS 特性;若旅程数据缺失,降级方案是至少保证「结尾不烂」。
fallback.en: The engineering exit: deterministic design at two moments — the peak (achievement, reveal, delight) and the ending (success page, completion state, exit confirmation). No CSS feature to degrade; if journey data is missing, the fallback is at least 'never botch the ending'.

use.zh: 表单提交成功页、任务完成态——值得单独打磨的「终」
use.en: Form success pages and completion states — the 'end' deserves its own craft

use.zh: 在最有价值的时刻投放惊喜(Mailchimp 发送成功动画,07§25)
use.en: Surprise at the most valuable moment (Mailchimp's send-success animation, 07 §25)

use.zh: 消除负面峰值:等待、报错、排队处专门做时间感知设计(Uber 案例,07§25)
use.en: Kill negative peaks: waiting, errors, queues deserve time-perception design (the Uber case, 07 §25)

avoid.zh: 把资源平均撒在全程,峰值与收尾反而潦草
avoid.en: Spreading resources evenly while the peak and the ending stay sloppy

avoid.zh: 在收尾插入打断(强制问卷、广告)制造负面终值
avoid.en: Interrupting the ending (forced surveys, ads) and manufacturing a negative end

a11y.zh: 曲线信息必须双通道:SVG 曲线之外,峰值/结尾/平均/记忆预测四组数值都以文本呈现(演示面板),不依赖颜色或形状传达结论;动画克制,尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
a11y.en: Curve information must be dual-channel: beyond the SVG, the four numbers (peak, end, average, memory prediction) all appear as text in the panel, never conveyed by color or shape alone; motion stays restrained and respects prefers-reduced-motion.

goal.zh: 画一段 8 时刻体验曲线(内联 SVG),峰值与结尾强度可调;面板同时显示「全程平均」与「峰终预测 (峰值+结尾)/2」两根对比条,并提供「平顺/惊喜收尾/烂尾」三种旅程预设。
goal.en: Draw an 8-moment experience curve (inline SVG) with adjustable peak and ending intensity; show 'full average' vs 'peak-end prediction (peak+end)/2' as comparison bars plus smooth/surprise-finale/botched-ending presets.

acceptance.zh: 峰值落在第 3 时刻、结尾在第 8 时刻,由 peak/ending 参数驱动,预设按钮直接写 store
acceptance.en: Peak at moment 3, end at moment 8, driven by peak/ending params; preset buttons write the store

acceptance.zh: 平均与峰终预测两根条实时重算,数值文本与曲线同步
acceptance.en: Average and peak-end prediction recompute live; numbers and curve stay in sync

acceptance.zh: 曲线用平滑折线,过渡 0.3s transform/attribute 动画,reduced-motion 时直接跳变
acceptance.en: Smooth polyline with 0.3s transitions; jumps instantly under reduced motion

acceptance.zh: 所有关键数值以文本呈现,不只靠曲线读图
acceptance.en: All key numbers appear as text, never readable only off the curve

acceptance.zh: 记忆预测标注「(峰值+结尾)/2 为教科书化简,非原始实验公式」
acceptance.en: Label the memory prediction as the textbook (peak+end)/2 simplification, not the raw experimental formula
